description: What a download window uses (D23, D43): the wirecatch://event stream, the app's name for titles, dragging the frameless window by its title bar, the folder picker for Change, and only the app's commands it calls. These windows show text that websites chose, so they get nothing that adds downloads, changes the list or queues, or reads or writes settings files, and the shell lets them act only on the question or download they show.
